channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mike Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mike Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jalen Brunson on Mike Brown, James Dolan
item.description:
“Thank you to [owner] Jim Dolan and the Knicks organization, [president] Leon [Rose], the front office, Mike Brown, my teammates— without them, none of this would be possible; they allow me to be me. I’m forever indebted to them.”

Jalen Brunson on Mike Brown, James Dolan, Jul 15, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Rick Brunson on Mike Brown
item.description:
Rick Brunson told The Athletic late Saturday night.

“And I had told him, ‘Build a good relationship with Jalen, and he’ll run through a wall for you.’ That’s what they both did (this season). This is amazing, man. Mike’s been amazing. He gives way too much credit to everybody else. This is Mike Brown.”

Rick Brunson on Mike Brown, Jun 15, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Mike Brown, Tyronn Lue
item.description:
“I ain’t never really heard too many people like Mike Brown — I ain’t saying they don’t, I just never heard nobody sing high praises for Mike Brown. “I never heard Bron say anything like Mike Brown is unbelievable. I mean, I never really heard Mike. He talked about Ty, Tyronn Lue. Yeah, that’s the only coach I ever heard him talk about.”

Jeff Teague on Mike Brown, Tyronn Lue, Jul 6, 2025. Source: Pro Football Network.

item.title: Jawad Williams on Mike Brown
item.description:
“When Mike Brown is going to go to bat for a guy like Jawad, Kenny’s going to listen.”

Jawad Williams on Mike Brown, Jun 19, 2025. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Mike Brown, Michael Malone, Taylor Jenkins
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle on Michael Malone, Mike Brown and Taylor Jenkins getting fired this season:

“If anyone would've told me any of these guys would've been fired midseason, I would've been shocked. ... It's disappointing,it's kinda numbing to be honest.”

Rick Carlisle on Mike Brown, Michael Malone, Taylor Jenkins, Apr 8, 2025. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Michael Malone, Mike Brown
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff on Mike Brown’s firing:

“Mike is one of these most classy guys we have in our profession. He’s one of the best people that I know. I’ll echo Mike Malone’s comments — the way it was handled was classless … the way you treat human beings matters.”

JB Bickerstaff on Michael Malone, Mike Brown, Dec 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Mike Brown
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on the Kings firing Mike Brown:

“He’s very good at what he does. In my opinion, one of the best. I wouldn’t be here without him. It’s sad news. I don’t like it. It’s part of the business. A year and a half ago he’s Coach of the Year and now this situation happens”

Jordi Fernandez on Mike Brown, Dec 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Mike Brown
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Mike Brown:

“Whatever you believe in, your culture and everything you want to build, try to do what’s best for the group, not for yourself. That’s what he’s always done since 16 years ago that I worked for him and he brought me into the U.S. to work in the NBA”

Jordi Fernandez on Mike Brown, Dec 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Mike Brown
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on his embrace with Mike Brown after tonight's Nets win:

“He is more than my mentor… It means the world to me because he’s the person who brought me to this point… I would not be here without him, so it was a special moment for me.”

Jordi Fernandez on Mike Brown, Nov 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Mike Brown
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry:

“We gave up 40 free throws. I don’t want to be Mike Brown up here going through them all to see how legit they are.”

Stephen Curry on Mike Brown, Jan 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: LeBron James on Mike Brown, De'Aaron Fox
item.description:
Jason Anderson:LeBron James on the Sacramento Kings:

“They got the reigning Coach of the Year. I know what Mike Brown is all about, being able to play for him for many years and then just seeing his growth... And D. Fox, he's getting better and better. So, they got a really good franchise.”

LeBron James on Mike Brown, De'Aaron Fox, Oct 30, 2023. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mike Brown
item.description:
Michael Malone:

“I wouldn’t be a head coach if it wasn’t for Mike Brown and the opportunities he gave me.”

Michael Malone on Mike Brown, Jun 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @NickFriedell.

item.title: Davion Mitchell on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Mike Brown
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Davion Mitchell on Kings coach Mike Brown:

“He held everyone accountable no matter who it was. I think he got on Fox and Sabonis more than anyone.”

Davion Mitchell on Domantas Sabonis, De'Aaron Fox, Mike Brown, May 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Monte McNair on Mike Brown
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Monte McNair on Kings coach Mike Brown:

“If he's not the coach of the year at this point, I think something's wrong.”

Monte McNair on Mike Brown, Feb 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Mike Brown
item.description:
Pop on Mike Brown's work with Kings:

“He’s done a great job, which is no surprise. He has got a lot of experience. He knows how to create relationships. He has high standards. He’ll hold everybody accountable, and it’s working. They're following his lead. I am thrilled for him.”

Gregg Popovich on Mike Brown, Jan 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Malik Monk on Mike Brown
item.description:
After Sacramento's 110-101 win over the Chicago Bulls on Sunday at Golden 1 Center,Malik Monk said the Kings are slowly turning that potential into a reality.

“We're legit, man. We're legit, because [Kings coach] Mike [Brown] is going to push us so hard that we can't not be legit,”

Malik Monk on Mike Brown, Dec 5, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Keegan Murray on Mike Brown
item.description:
Keegan Murray on Mike Brown:

“I knew coach Brown was going to bring energy and that’s exactly what he did. I was happy to see that because that’s not something you normally get out of a head coach, so I thought that was pretty cool how he connected with his players today.”

Keegan Murray on Mike Brown, Sep 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Andrew Bogut on Mike Brown, Harrison Barnes
item.description:
“Mike Brown loves him. I have a feeling they might bring him in. They need someone that’s a pro every day. Harrison Barnes is that guy, but it would help to have another guy like that in the locker room with the young guys.”

Andrew Bogut on Mike Brown, Harrison Barnes, Jul 21, 2022. Source: Fresno Bee.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Mike Brown
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Mike Brown being hired by the Kings:

“I don't even know where to begin. What Mike has done for me, for this organization in his six years here, he's made just an incredible contribution. He's an amazing coach, amazing friend, and Sacramento made a great choice.”

Steve Kerr on Mike Brown, May 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @markhaynesnba.

item.title: Gabe Vincent on Mike Brown
item.description:
“Mike Brown has definitely been in contact. He's been great reaching out to guys, communicating well and we're all looking forward to it and excited.”

Gabe Vincent on Mike Brown, Jun 18, 2021. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Ron Adams, Mike Brown
item.description:
“Fundamental details. I’m seeing deficiencies where, with our last team, they just automatically made up for a mistake by making four straight 3s and blowing a game open. I’m now forced to figure out what the deficiency is and how to solve it. So I’m relying more on Mike Brown and Ron Adams for that. Both guys are more detailed than I am as a coach.”

Steve Kerr on Ron Adams, Mike Brown, Dec 24, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Michael Malone on Mike Brown
item.description:
“I had five great years here. During that five-year stretch we had great success –- best record in the NBA twice, went to the Finals. I was very fortunate to work for a head in Mike Brown that allowed me to coach and gave me a voice and gave me a platform. Because of that opportunity and the success that we had -– because of a guy like LeBron (James) – that allowed me to be seen in a different light amongst NBA GMs and owners. And ultimately allowed me to become a head coach. So this was a great time for me and my family, great success. And it was a huge factor in me becoming a head coach in the NBA.”

Michael Malone on Mike Brown, Feb 12, 2017. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on Mike Brown
item.description:
“This is a very tough business. It pains all of us here that we needed to make the difficult decision of releasing Mike Brown. Mike worked hard over this last season to move our team in the right direction. Although, there was some progress from our finish over the few prior seasons,we believe we need to head in a different direction. We wish Mike and his family nothing but the best,”

Dan Gilbert on Mike Brown, May 12, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Andrew Bynum, Phil Jackson, Mike Brown
item.description:
“So, I think it was easier to do when Phil Jackson and his staff was around. Then, when asked if Brown had provided that same culture for Bynum when he coached in Los Angeles, Gasol responded: “Nah. Not the same.”

Pau Gasol on Andrew Bynum, Phil Jackson, Mike Brown, Mar 1, 2014. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on Mike Brown
item.description:
“I am more than excited about Mike Brown’s return to the Cleveland Cavaliers. Mike has done nothing but win in this league since he was a first-year assistant many years ago. He is going to instill a much-needed defensive-first philosophy in our young and talented team that is going to serve as our foundation and identity as we continue down the path of building the kind of franchise that competes at a championship level for many years to come,”

Dan Gilbert on Mike Brown, Apr 24, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Mike Brown
item.description:
“Mike Brown is a great coach. But sometimes there's a disconnect. When that happens, then it changes — the players buy in quicker, and they're ready to get down another road.”

Mike D'Antoni on Mike Brown, Nov 23, 2012. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Mike Brown
item.description:
“He's been the face of this franchise for so many years. I mean, he's the Laker legend. … But I can only speak from personal experience and my dealings with Jim; he's been great with me outside of the Mike Brown hiring which I didn't know anything about. You know everything else we have just kind of been in constant communications, constant dialogue about it.”

Kobe Bryant on Mike Brown, Nov 21, 2012. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Phil Jackson, Mike Brown
item.description:
So how exactly did the Lakers go from nearly 95% sure Jackson was their man to D'Antoni?

“When we relieved Mike [Brown] of his duties, clearly what we anticipated took place, which was a groundswell of support for Phil Jackson,”

Mitch Kupchak on Phil Jackson, Mike Brown, Nov 16, 2012. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Steve Blake on Mike Brown
item.description:
Kristen Blake wrote on Twitter:

“Leave Mike Brown’s son alone. What’s wrong with u people?! Stop attacking FAMILIES! How would you feel if YOUR family was treated like that?”

Steve Blake on Mike Brown, Nov 9, 2012. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Jerry Buss on Mike Brown
item.description:
Here's how Lakers executive vice president Jim Buss, just two-plus weeks ago, put his feelings – and those of general manager Mitch Kupchak and Lakers owner Jerry Buss:

“I'm a hundred percent behind Mike Brown. Mitch is. My dad is. We as a collective soul are behind him 100 percent.”

Jerry Buss on Mike Brown, Nov 6, 2012. Source: Orange County Register.
